sheets.title: Cluster 1 — Basin Survey
sheets.note: The first settled basin, drawn at cluster scale — zones, roads, and hazard bands from content/spine/.

sheets.title: The Atlas World — Mariners' Chart
sheets.note: The compiled world chart — every cluster, tier, and boundary in one sheet.

sheets.title: Target-Density Canary
sheets.note: NOT GEOGRAPHY — a synthetic sheet at the agreed target density (13 landmasses, 160 regions, 1,740 landform instances, 340 labels) on the atlas sheet's own 400 km frame. It exists so a render regression at scale is visible before the real world exists.

sheets.title: The Generated World — Fabric Survey
sheets.note: 13 landmasses, 160 regions, 45 settlements, 38 roads and 2 sea lanes drawn straight from content/world/fabric/ — the generated layer, before any authored meaning is joined on. The 40 surveyed regions are inked; the 120 reported ones are bare parchment, which is spec §6.4's honest-frontier gradient drawn rather than described. No names: naming is Plan D's.

sheets.title: Coastline Overlay — Baseline vs Generated
sheets.note: Today's committed coastline ghosted under the generated one, with a per-continent area-delta table joined through the manifest's landmasses[].nodeId. Gross land 6,243.5 → 65,600.0 km² (x10.51); sea:land 24.68 : 1 → 1.50 : 1. Read from the draft folder's baseline/, never from git.
